title: Structured output rotational fuzz and decoder fallback tests
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Problem: As we roll out more strict JSON mode enforcement and support live schema rotations for structured outputs, we need to validate decoder behavior across a range of real-world failure modes. Current unit tests cover happy-path schema validation and some streaming partial JSON recovery, but we lack a focused suite that stresses: (1) schema rotations (old->new->rollback) in-flight, (2) constrained-decoder edge cases (soft vs hard failures), (3) streaming partial-object recovery when tool/function call tokens are interleaved, and (4) compatibility with older clients that expect permissive decoding. Goal: build an automated test harness and a set of deterministic fuzz scenarios that run across hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments to catch regressions early and provide actionable signals for rollback policies. This ticket scopes test design, harness implementation, and an initial set of failing test vectors to be fixed by the runtime team.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic harness (CLI + CI job) exists that can run schema-rotation and decoder-fuzz suites end-to-end against a dev runtime and an instrumented local API proxy
At least 30 unique fuzz vectors covering: truncated streams, extra trailing tokens, tool-call delimiter corruption, overlapping KV cache prefixes, and schema downgrade messages
Constrained decoder must surface a consistent failure type string for soft failures (e.g., 'decoder_soft_violation') and hard failures ('decoder_hard_violation'), with telemetry hooks for each

Streaming partial JSON recovery tests demonstrate prefix-preserve behavior: when prefix is valid and remainder fails, runtime returns structured error with the last-valid-path and a graceful fallback path
Compatibility check pass/fail matrix produced for clients using legacy permissive decoding versus strict JSON mode
CI gate added: if new commits increase hard-failure rate > 0.5% on the canonical fuzz suite, block merge and auto-assign to runtime-oncall
tasks: Design fuzz vector taxonomy and write human-readable catalog (conserved by test harness)
Implement harness: runners for streaming, tool-call simulation, and schema-rotation orchestrator
Instrument decoder to emit classified failure tags and add telemetry counters
Create CI job + baseline golden outputs and failure thresholds
Run smoke runs across hosted, dedicated, and private dev clusters and gather flaky cases
Document rollback criteria for schema rotations (when to canary, abort, or force-rollback)
Land initial fixes for the top 5 failing vectors and re-run suite
test_plan: Schema rotation scenarios: deploy schema v1, stream live requests, push v2 with incompatible field rename, simulate client pinned to v1 => assert decoder containment and explicit compatibility violation telemetry
Rollback scenario: introduce v2 then rollback to v1 mid-stream and verify runtime tombstones incompatible responses rather than silent corruption

Constrained-decoder soft failure: input that violates optional constraints only (e.g., enum out-of-range) => decoder returns structured warning and fallback to permissive path for backwards compatibility mode
Constrained-decoder hard failure: malformed JSON mid-stream or control character injection => decoder returns hard failure, request marked for retry/fallback routing
Streaming partial JSON: inject truncated JSON at token boundaries and verify prefix-preserve and last-valid-path fields in response
Tool/function call delimiter fuzz: corrupt function call opener/closer tokens and verify tool-call sanitizer and telemetry events
KV cache collision test: reuse cache keys across different sequence lengths with concurrent requests to surface cross-request bleed-through
Client compatibility matrix: run each vector with 'permissive-client', 'strict-client', and 'compat-client' modes and record behavior differences
metrics: hard_failure_rate: percentage of requests classified as 'decoder_hard_violation'
soft_failure_rate: percentage of requests classified as 'decoder_soft_violation'
prefix_preserve_success: percent of truncated-stream cases where last-valid-path is returned
compatibility_delta: fraction of vectors where permissive-client succeeds but strict-client fails
ci_block_rate: frequency of CI runs blocked by fuzz-suite threshold
